Step 4 of 6 · Pride
What is something you did today that you are proud of?

A student helping another, a colleague going out of their way, a stranger's small gesture.

Even if it felt completely ordinary to you — someone probably felt it.

Trip:
📊 Form Readiness
💊 Medical Info Needed Per Student
Each student's parent must complete the Medical Information section. Remind parents to include:
  • Medical history (asthma, diabetes, genetic disorders)
  • All allergies (medication / seasonal / stings / food)
  • Current medications & dosage
  • Any special needs or accommodations (noted on school file)
  • Emergency medication — self-carry or clinic
⚠️School-supplied epinephrine will NOT be sent on any field trip per CCPS Policy 4134.
ℹ️For overnight trips: medication must be brought to the clinic by a parent/guardian no later than 3 business days before the trip.
📄 Form Preview
ℹ️
Conference Approval / Professional Leave Request — Required for all off-site conferences, competitions (DECA, etc.), and workshops. Submit in advance to Principal/Supervisor. Category III (School Related) covers field trips & competitions.
Event:
📊 Readiness Checklist
🔑 Category Guide
Cat I — Professional Leave (PR1): Off-site conferences, workshops, recruiting. Needs Principal + Director + (out-of-state: CAO).
Cat II — District Leave (PR2): In-district PD, curriculum development, department training. Needs Principal.
Cat III — School/Discretionary (PR3): Field trips & competitions. Needs Principal only.
Cat IV — Other (PR4): Needs Principal + Director + CAO.
⚠️Requests must be made in advance. CTE programs must also complete the CTE Professional Development Travel Request if travel expenses are involved.

        What is an SBE?
        A School-Based Enterprise is a HQWBL experience where students design, plan, operate, and grow a real business on campus. The Cavalier Shop (8177) qualifies as a Retail Store SBE under CCPS Group III procedures.
        Required: Training Agreement · Student Reflection · Business Plan · Principal Approval
        Required SBE Elements (CCPS Business Plan Approval Checklist)
        Required Documentation
        📄 Training Agreement
        Signed by student, parent, teacher & mentor. Required for HQWBL credit.
        ⬜ Not collected

        End-of-experience reflection. Required for HQWBL completion.
        ⬜ Not collected
        📊 Daily Financial Summary
        Daily recap of sales, deposits & transactions per CCPS Policy 7060.
        ⬜ Not set up

        Every purchase at the Cavalier Shop follows a 3-step approval cycle per the Store Scaling & Reinvestment Plan: student-led market research → formal Purchase Requisition → CTE Chair + Admin approval. Items ship to the back room where students execute the full receiving process.

        NOVELTYLanyards, foam fingers, accessories

        📧 Email Bridge Setup
        ⭐ Star any email in Gmail — it appears on your dashboard within 5 minutes. No API key. No labeling. One tap on mobile or desktop.
        Paste the URL from Apps Script → Deploy → Manage Deployments
        Quick Setup (do once — ~10 min):
        1. Open script.google.com → New Project → paste EmailBridge.gs
        2. Add one Script Property: SHEET_URL → your LeaderHub Inbox sheet URL
        3. Run firstTimeSetup() once to verify everything
        4. Deploy as Web App (Execute as: Me, Access: Anyone)
        5. Set a 5-minute trigger on processStarred
        No GEMINI_API_KEY needed. The only property is SHEET_URL.
        Full guide: LEADERHUB_EMAIL_SETUP.md
        Optional: real AI drafting for Brag Board — once the Apps Script above is deployed, "✨ Generate" can produce an actual AI-written draft instead of a template, via a separate Google Workspace Flow (no API key — uses your Workspace account's own Gemini access). Fully optional: without it, Brag Board keeps working exactly as it does today. See LEADERHUB_AI_FLOW_SETUP.md.
